snippet.title: Arcane Eats - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Arcane Eats – where magic meets the menu and culinary chaos reigns supreme!

Hungry adventurers and ravenous monsters are flooding the realm in search of the ultimate meal… and you’re the chef they’re counting on. In Arcane Eats, you’ll conjure up your own enchanted restaurant, crafting a custom deck of mythic ingredients, spellbound cooking tools, and culinary incantations. Strategize each turn, serve demanding customers, and rise through the ranks of magical cooking guilds to earn your Mythril star!

Steam Store Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640090

 Key Features:

No recipes required – Craft your cuisine deck with 100s of fantastical cards
Manage the madness – Juggle orders, cash flow, and demanding health inspectors
Join heroic cooking guilds – Each with their own playstyle and powerful combos
Satisfy the strange – From demon food critics to mysterious regulars, learn what they crave
Endless replayability – New cards, kitchen upgrades, and surprises every run

From the creators at Wonderbelly Games, Arcane Eats blends deckbuilding, strategy, and cozy chaos into one delicious roguelike dish. Much more will be served soon...
